scope: Bounded Node VM fixtures execute actual reward/session source and extracted actual placement helpers using mocked native/Android replies. No native firing, construction, wallet storage, real wave clearing, browser, emulator or gameplay verified. Java guards and touch routing are source-inspected only.

checks.name: Bulk native item quantities pass unchanged; native and durable phone acknowledgements gate readiness
Malformed quantities, stale sessions, native rejection and failed durable acknowledgement fail closed
Rewards stays read-only in-game and opens only after Build exit
Exit quote is fetched once and synchronously forwarded to durable phone inventory before resolving
Inventory stale/error/timeout/phone-save failure returns false and never forwards an invalid snapshot
Dispose ignores late apply/inventory results and clears polling/notification state
Actual cleared-wave IDs and remaining quote are forwarded before terminal settlement, without inferring clears from wave number
Confirmed Home return waits for the inventory quote and accepts one return request
Back cancels satellite targeting before opening another menu
Satellite arms only from the selected ready native-post quote and fires only after a terrain target
Satellite arming requires successful Build exit and a fresh successful state reply
Newer navigation supersedes a pending fresh satellite query and its late acknowledgement cannot arm
Back cancels pending satellite arming and ignores the late fresh state acknowledgement
Back also cancels satellite arming while Build exit is pending; late close never requests or arms targeting
Native satellite rejection is reported and targeting ends; no stock click is required
Purchased fortress lines are disabled, while ordinary, naturally unlocked and purchased non-fortress defence lines remain
Purchased building taps reserve native quotas through queue-build; natural/unpaid paths preserve native Ctrl-click ownership
Dormant Duel has no portable reward module or reward-progress forwarding

sourceAuditOnly: Touch target precedes ordinary world/facility taps and is limited to stationary battlefield touch
